paragraphs: We offer Underslung Cranes with compact design and making it lightweight, easy to operate. Quite similar to EOT Cranes these also come with similar variation in them, such as single or dual disc electromagnetic brakes feature, that provide the automatic braking, in case of sudden power failure occuring at location and various types of limit switches and push button station options are also provided.

The motors that are used in the operation, can be selcted depending upon application. These type of cranes are used where there is a space constraint for EOT Cranes. These cranes are of great use for lifting and moving of the material from one location to another.
These cranes come with speed variations,such as single speed or dual speed. Also we provide the option of independent moving push button for shifting and moving of oversize jobs.
Sahil Industries is having expertise in manufacturing world class under slung cranes, keeping 'safety with equivalent quality' in mind.
